note: Open: the bands call `complaint_rate_elevated` acceptable, because 0.16% is over the 0.10% line but the week is low volume. The call is that it is wrong here: the rate is one complaint in 640 messages, the week before carried a mailing of 46,000, and people report mail days after it arrives, so that one report almost certainly belongs to last week's mailing, where it is a rate near zero; the grade is steady at high and opens are flat. Raising it would send the client to clean a list that drew one complaint from 46,000 messages. The 0.10% line comes from the bulk-sender requirements published by Google; the lag in complaints is general practice.
